title: Hackers vs. Security: Attack-Defence Trees as Asynchronous Multi-Agent Systems
review_status: full-text section audit complete; formal case-study verification, not operational security validation
sections_checked: three case studies and agent coalition results
Uppaal comparison, runtime, state-space tradeoff, and future work
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 submitted 2019-06-12; University of Twente record lists publication in 2019.
evidence_note: Formal EAMAS transformation is proved correct for stated semantics and compared on three literature-derived case studies. IoT-device example reports coalition-dependent minimum time (694 vs 784 minutes under different agent allocation). EAMAS is exact in stated comparison but costs about 3x computation in one setup; state-space growth harms quantitative queries. No real adversary/incident outcome evaluation.

title: Explaining Agent Behavior with Large Language Models
review_status: full-text section audit complete; bounded participant preference and small hallucination study
sections_checked: decision-tree distillation and behavior representation method
evidence_note: Decision-tree surrogate path grounds GPT-4 natural-language explanations. In 32 participants, proposed explanations beat templates by preference; participants did not prefer human-written over proposed explanations. Interactive follow-up n=5. Hallucination comparison uses 30 generated explanations across optimal/suboptimal/fixed policies. Authors state surrogate is approximate, so explanation faithfulness to the actual policy is not guaranteed; single 2D USAR setting and GPT-4.

title: A New Framework for Cybersecurity Refusals in AI Agents
review_status: full-text section audit complete; mode-specific benchmark result with five trials per model/challenge
evidence_note: Eight named models, 29 challenges/nine vulnerability categories; five trials. Six models have <=5% refusal in the reported medium proxy mode; GPT-5.2 is 62%. Hard mode uses nine remote-site reconnaissance/planning tasks with exploitation prohibited; only 18/800 trajectories show desired behavior. LLM judge grades local capability. Snapshot depends on model/scaffold/task framing; real-site behavior is not active-exploitation performance.
